provenance.notes: Default-mode values are read literally. Entries marked derived:true (compact mode, dark neutrals, motion durations) are computed by mirroring upstream formulas; the script asserts each formula is still in the source and that the mirror reproduces the published default output.

controls.note: Component size prop small/middle/large selects controlHeightSM/controlHeight/controlHeightLG. There is no touch mode and no touch-target token.

spacing.note: sizeUnit 4 × (sizeStep 4 + n). padding*/margin* alias the size tokens.

focusRing.note: lineWidthFocus = lineWidth × 3 is the outline width of keyboard focus; controlOutlineWidth is the 2px focus shadow of inputs. No offset token (offset 1px is a literal in the focus mixin).

typography.note: fontSize(i) = even floor of 14 × e^(i/5); lineHeight = (fontSize + 8) / fontSize.

motion.note: dist/antd.css publishes the three durations as 0s because the static stylesheet is generated with motion off; the values here follow the seed formula.

structure.note: Seed colours (primary, success, warning, error, info, link, textBase, bgBase) → 10-step palette per seed → named map tokens (Bg, BgHover, Border, BorderHover, Hover, base, Active, TextHover, Text, TextActive). Neutrals are alpha steps of textBase and lightness steps of bgBase.

algorithm.name: defaultAlgorithm / darkAlgorithm / compactAlgorithm (theme.algorithm, composable)
outputs: 381 global CSS variables in the default output
map tokens: colour palettes, sizes, heights, font sizes and line heights, radii, motion durations
alias tokens: paddings, margins, shadows, screen breakpoints, control tokens
algorithm.description: generate() in @ant-design/colors builds 10 steps from one colour in HSV: 5 lighter steps (hue ±2° per step, saturation −0.16, value +0.05) and 4 darker (saturation +0.05, value −0.15), index 6 being the seed. Dark mode mixes those steps into the dark background by fixed amounts (darkColorMap). The dark algorithm also remaps hover/active steps and rebuilds neutrals from bgBase #000 / textBase #fff.

findings: No seed, map or alias token concerns direction, language or script (see patterns: the scan of es/theme/ and the token JSON finds no Arabic, bidi, :dir or :lang match). The single font stack is Latin system fonts plus 'Noto Sans' (not Noto Sans Arabic).
Component tokens that name RTL: Tabs.horizontalItemMarginRTL.
Direction is a ConfigProvider prop (`direction`), applied as a `-rtl` class per component; styles use logical properties (padding-inline, margin-inline-start).
Line height is a pure function of font size, (fontSize + 8) / fontSize, for every language: 14px → 22px, 12px → 20px. Locale files exist for ar_EG, fa_IR, he_IL, ku_IQ, ur_PK but carry strings only.
Density has two independent axes: the compact ALGORITHM (controlHeight − 4, font 14 → 12, spacing step −2) and the per-component SIZE prop (small/middle/large = ×0.75/×1/×1.25 of controlHeight).
